documents.creator: Young to Allison, US State Department
documents.findings: Korean objection to joint control of all FX on sovereignty grounds; State vs Defense disagreement; rate 6000 vs suggested >=10000.

documents.creator: Muccio/Lightner, US Embassy
documents.findings: Rhee told US envoy he authorized Finance Minister Paek to sign agreement; urged prompt won-advance settlement and dollar backing for currency conversion.

documents.creator: C. E. Meyer to Secretary of State
documents.findings: Agreement signed May24; Combined Economic Board one representative each; FX coordination; 1952 Jan-May won drawings 6000:1, 4 million dollars monthly for future military won advances; TIAS2593 original treaty target.
